role: RECORD OF A REPAIR PASS. This file seals nothing, advances no status, changes no verdict, disposition or seal, and touches no [UNSET]. CD-RT-5 remains BLOCKED_ON_PHASE_1A. It records which checkers in the tasked set were given a duplicate-key guard, which could not be and why, and the measured result of each attack.

theConstraintThatShapedThisPass.ruleAsBriefed: Freeze 7.2 binds a verdict to bytes AND an environment. A checker may be edited only if no review that recorded running it is still live.
theConstraintThatShapedThisPass.secondConstraintFoundByMeasurement: A checker may ALSO be pinned by an EXECUTABLE digest check inside a sibling checker. That pin is not a paper reference: it changes the sibling's stdout the moment the target's bytes change. The prior pass named this class PINNED-BY-CHECKER / BLOCKED-UNREPAIRABLE-IN-PLACE. Four of the six initially tasked files fall in it, which the tasking's review-artifact-only exposure measurement did not cover.
theConstraintThatShapedThisPass.method: sha256 of each target computed, then every file under docs/coop scanned for that digest at 64-, 32-, 16-, 12- and 8-character prefixes in both cases; each pinner then checked for citation in IMPLEMENTATION-FREEZE.md and IMPLEMENTER-BLUEPRINT.md; then every checker's full stdout, stderr and exit code captured before and after and compared byte-for-byte.

repaired.shape: One hooked entry point per file, every parse routed through it, modelled on check-package-coherence.py. Named exception type DuplicateKeyError (the corpus-dominant name, used by 30+ checkers) so the failure is greppable and cannot be confused with a malformed-document error. The hook NAMES the duplicated key.

repaired.whatWasNotChanged: No verdict logic, threshold, output string, exit code or finding text. The only edits are the hook definition, the entry point, and the call sites. Confirmed by byte-for-byte comparison of stdout and stderr before and after, plain and --selftest.

attacks.shape: Order-preserving duplicate insert (the sweep's shape C): the duplicate is placed IMMEDIATELY BEFORE the real member, so a stock last-wins parse reproduces the honest document in value AND in dict key order. Only the bytes differ. Each mutant was asserted equal to the honest document under stock json.loads, in both value and key order, before being used.
attacks.whyNotExitCodes: A non-zero exit is not evidence a guard fired. Every rejection below was confirmed by READING the message and seeing the duplicated key NAMED. Each attack was additionally run against a pre-repair control — the identical file with only the object_pairs_hook argument removed — to prove the guard is what fired and not something else.

residualExposure.structuralObservation: A self-pinned checker — one that hashes its own bytes against a value recorded in the artifact it validates — can never be repaired in place. It is freeze §7.6's 'immutability prevents a proven fix from propagating', in its sharpest form: the only route is a new version alongside, which is a decision for the freeze owner, not for this pass.
